question: 计算机化与AI相关工作中，一般资历、任务和行业经历如何对应公开招聘要求及实际人员进入？不预设两类技术方向相反。

experience_objects.general_work: explicit general employment experience; unresolved object remains separate
experience_objects.occupation_task: explicit prior work in a named occupation or activity; responsibility alone is not evidence of prior experience
experience_objects.industry_domain: explicit prior sector/domain/client-market work or required domain knowledge; knowledge without prior-work wording is a separate condition
experience_objects.specific_tool: split proficiency, training/certification, and explicit prior use; proficiency alone is not tenure

technology_rules: applicant-specific evidence required; company marketing is not applicant role
using AI to develop software does not alone establish developing AI
legacy predictive-AI structural zeros remain NA; no revived C2 contrast
role labels and outcome labels audited jointly; no detected AI is not known non-adoption
duration_rules: bind number to explicit object and qualification branch
bare 3 years is stated value with unspecified bound unless source language defines minimum/exact/range
education-equivalence conversion is not general tenure
retain required versus preferred and AND/OR/EQUIVALENT relationships
joint_time_rule: no calendar-quarter joint key or same-period requirements without independently verified body-version dates; CREATED only first-observed cohort

source_time.linkup: mixed-vintage saved descriptions; no cohort historical requirement inference
source_time.revelio: actual position dates subject to retrospective coverage/month ordering/update lag

revelio_principles: union overlapping intervals within each experience object
risk set fixed at baseline; missing updates not automatically no transition

linkup_estimands.old_groups: within-old-cell design-weighted difference standardized using original pooled cell weights
linkup_estimands.reclassified_groups: only reclassified sampled old frame; retain original inclusion probability; recompute support once and report weight lost
linkup_estimands.tenure_conditioned: descriptive among ads disclosing comparable general tenure; not total causal effect

gates.unknown_action: downgrade affected comparison; show identifiable subset and conservative unknown bounds; do not imply bounds cover undetected misclassification

production_prerequisites: actual final-model batch endpoint and permitted data-processing route
current_unsupported_claims: technology causal effect from role-group differences
historical requirement changes from current body plus CREATED
AI-human or model-model agreement as truth accuracy
full platform/national population from old screened candidate frame
legacy_policy: v1 six tables immutable; v2 supersedes v1 joint time key and event partition, not historical results

current_data_availability.LinkUp: existing records and descriptions processed into frozen v1 products
current_data_availability.Revelio_Individual: not acquired; empirical work deferred by user on 2026-10-04
